title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of positive predictions (true positives plus false positives). Think about how changing the threshold might affect the number of false positives.

title: Threshold and Precision
text: Increasing the threshold generally means that the model becomes more selective in classifying a positive case. Consider how this selectivity might impact the number of false positives and true positives.

title: Effect on Precision
text: If the threshold is increased, what happens to the number of false positives?

title: Recall and Threshold
text: Recall is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total number of actual positives (true positives plus false negatives). Consider how increasing the threshold might affect the number of true positives.

title: Effect on Recall
text: If the threshold is increased, what happens to the number of true positives?

title: Accuracy and Threshold
text: Accuracy is the ratio of correct predictions (both true positives and true negatives) to the total number of predictions. Think about how changing the threshold might affect both true positives and true negatives.

title: Effect on Accuracy
text: If the threshold is increased, what happens to the number of true negatives?
